summary: Iter-10: Validated Şampiyon AI chat fix (slow/broken multi-turn bug). Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_sampiyon_regression.py — 4/4 PASS covering (1) single-turn chat Türkçe reply (no 'Hata:' prefix, uses tools), (2) multi-turn with assistant in history → 200 (previous 500 bug fixed), (3) /api/sampiyon/tts returns audio/mpeg 200 with speed=1.15, (4) speed clamping (speed=10.0 → still 200). Frontend: Playwright e2e via preview URL — logged in as Murat, opened sampiyon-fab→panel, confirmed sampiyon-mic exists, sent 'Stokta kaç çeşit lastik var?' got valid Turkish reply with tool trace, then sent follow-up 'Peki bu ayki gelir gider özeti ne?' with assistant history → second reply arrived in ~10s, no error, '2 araç kullandı' tool pill visible; Oku button triggered /api/sampiyon/tts → HTTP 200 audio/mpeg. All critical regression paths green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~2493 lines — still past 700-line soft limit; split into routers overdue (unchanged from iter-9).

Şampiyon chat: history is truncated to last 10 messages but tool_result pairing is NOT preserved across turns — frontend only sends role/content pairs, so if a prior turn used tools, the LLM's internal tool_use blocks are lost. Current initial_messages approach is safe because only textual user/assistant alternation is reconstructed, but it means the model cannot 'remember' prior tool results beyond what it already summarized in text. Document this limitation.

SampiyonChatIn.history accepts arbitrary dicts (List[dict]) without a Pydantic sub-model — switch to List[ChatHistoryItem] for schema validation and reject invalid roles with 422 instead of silently dropping.
Backend /sampiyon/chat has no rate limit; a client stuck in a retry loop could exhaust the LLM key budget. Consider per-user QPS throttle.
TTS endpoint reads entire audio into memory then re-streams — for the 4000-char cap this is fine (<1MB) but could use direct passthrough for lower latency.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 new regression + 61/61 prior suite still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, panel open, mic presence, single-turn, multi-turn, TTS)

rca of the issue: Original bug: /api/sampiyon/chat called a non-existent chat.add_assistant_message() while rebuilding history, raising 500 on every follow-up turn. Fix in server.py L2203-2219: history is now sanitized (user/assistant only, non-empty, leading-user guarantee) and passed via LlmChat(initial_messages=[system]+history) — verified by multi-turn test and live UI second-message flow.
